- **Q1 FY2026** (12 weeks ended November 23, 2025): operating income was $2,463 million.
- **Q4 FY2026**: full-year operating income of $11,685 million less the 36-week year-to-date figure of $7,884 million (through May 10, 2026) gives $3,801 million.
- **Change:** (3,801 − 2,463) / 2,463 ≈ 54.3%.

Q4 covers 16 weeks, against 12 weeks for Q1, so part of the increase reflects the longer quarter.
